design_philosophy: Mobile-first financial dashboard prioritizing trust, clarity, and familial warmth. Avoids the 'sterile fintech' look by using rounded, friendly typography for headings, while maintaining rigorous data clarity. The requested teal gradient is elevated to a deep, cinematic cyan/emerald blend to feel premium.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: Mobile-first, generous internal padding for breathing room.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4 md:gap-6

header.admin: Uses 'primary.gradient' with white text, spanning full width, rounded-b-3xl shadow-md pb-8 pt-6 px-6. Content floats over this via negative margin.
header.socio: Similar to admin, providing a unified brand experience.

bottom_navigation.style: fixed bottom-0 w-full z-50 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-slate-200 pb-safe pt-2 px-4 flex justify-between items-center h-16
bottom_navigation.active_item: text-teal-700 font-bold flex flex-col items-center gap-1
bottom_navigation.inactive_item: text-slate-500 flex flex-col items-center gap-1 hover:text-slate-700 transition-colors

buttons.primary: h-12 px-6 rounded-xl font-semibold tracking-wide transition-all duration-200 shadow-sm active:scale-95
buttons.approve: h-10 px-4 rounded-lg font-medium bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white active:scale-95
buttons.reject: h-10 px-4 rounded-lg font-medium bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-500 text-white active:scale-95

icons_and_assets.logo_instructions:
Build an inline SVG or compose using Lucide icons:
, paired with typography 'AhorroFamiliar'.

animation_and_motion.list_stagger: Use framer-motion to stagger list items (loans, members) on load. Delay: 0.05s per item.
animation_and_motion.page_load: Fade in and slide up slightly (y: 10 -> 0).

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure white text on teal gradients meets WCAG AA 4.5:1. Use text-shadow if necessary.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid. Examples: data-testid='login-button', data-testid='approve-loan-button', data-testid='nav-inicio'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a Single Login screen with a beautiful full-cover background image (use 'hero_background') with a dark overlay, floating white glassmorphism card for the login form.
Admin Dashboard: Render a massive, immersive gradient header using the specified primary gradient. The total cash data should float inside this header.
Socio Dashboard: Follow the same structure but focus on 'Mi Ahorro' and 'Deuda'.
Upload Comprobante: Use a drag-and-drop or simple file input styled elegantly with Lucide's UploadCloud icon.
Use Shadcn UI extensively: Tabs (for Spanish/English toggle), Dialog (for loan voting), Card (for everything), Avatar (for users).
Add 'pb-24' to the main layout to ensure the bottom navigation doesn't cut off content.
Implement the Language Toggle smoothly, ideally in the Profile section or top header corner.
DO NOT use raw HTML date inputs. Use Shadcn if needed, but primarily build customized cards.
For the Logo, compose it using Lucide icons as specified in 'logo_instructions'.
